newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade active in the panhandle area Wednesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady to 1.00 higher. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 41,100 slaughter steers and 26,200 heifers; 121,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 21,900 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00
to mostly 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 63.00.
Pen Select and Choice 1-3 1200 lb Holsteins 55.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00 to mostly 64.00.
Week to date 121,700 Week Ago 81,300 Year Ago 65,500.
